verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a built-in AI assistant in Stripe Radar or its Dashboard that users can delegate tasks to. The documented items are rules, review queues, risk settings, analytics, an MCP server and a CLI. The MCP server and CLI are developer interfaces belonging to other stories, not an in-product assistant. Radar's ML risk scoring is automated fraud detection, not task delegation to an assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
